title: Brett Leatherman to WEF path through FBI Cyber Division
summary: Verified chain:Leatherman leads FBI Cyber Division; that division contributed experts to WEF's Partnership Against Cybercrime study; WEF operates the initiative.

sources.title: Ahead of the Threat Podcast:Season 2, Episode 0:Brett Leatherman
Tackling the Cyber Threat as a Global Community

data.question: Can the Leatherman-WEF path be strengthened beyond Operation Cronos coverage?
data.method: Recursive organization and initiative tracing using official FBI and WEF sources.
findings: Leatherman leads the FBI Cyber Division.
FBI Cyber Division experts participated in WEF's Partnership Against Cybercrime study.
WEF created and operates that initiative.
A division-level institutional WEF path is established.
Leatherman's personal participation in the 2020 study is not established.
conclusions: Retain Leatherman in WEF through the verified institutional path.
Upgrade classification from content exposure to division-level participation.
Do not claim personal WEF membership or working-group participation.
limitations: The FBI statement does not name the participating experts.
Leatherman's exact assignment during each phase of the 2020 study remains unresolved.
